snippet.title: Grid Realm // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4490290/Grid_Realm/

A lightweight city-building game with LowPoly style. No complex management or resource systems here—just pure and simple building. Choose your favorite buildings and create your ideal city according to your preferences.

Developed by
Soft Fire​
